result:
I accepted the TK-009 July report and closed the ticket: none of the 33 variants became a candidate.

**What I checked:** I recomputed the baseline and h4-900 from the trade closes on the Steam Deck; both match the report. h4-900 fails the "without any single day" condition on the same days as in the report: 6, 7 and 8 July. After correcting for 33 tests, no money difference is significant.

**h4-900 (wall age at least 15 minutes):**
- It made money in all three months (Aug +$286, Sep +$123, Jul +$358). But it did not pass the out-of-sample test: its KPI was at or below 0.10 only in September.
- Before any decision on it, the Researcher needs to show two things. One is the maximum number of positions open at once. The other is the same variant with a cap of 3 positions, for August, September and July. It makes 3.5 times as many trades as the baseline with no position cap, so its profit mixes edge with extra risk taken.
- July is now used up for it; only a new protocol on data after September can confirm it.

The review is in `docs/research/reviews/tk009-july-2026-09-28.md`.
